rationale: B has a clearer evaluator/compiler structure and a more robust token loop: it supports definitions embedded among other tokens, multiple definitions per line, and continued execution after a semicolon, whereas A assumes any definition occupies an entire line and starts at its first token. Its compile, parseNumber, and binop helpers make the parsing and execution rules explicit and readable. A has slightly better reuse of sentinel errors and distinguishes empty from one-item stacks more precisely, but B’s broader syntactic robustness and cleaner separation of concerns outweigh those minor issues.
